_comment: The symbols the card EXPECTS to see. This list exists so a symbol that
stops reporting entirely shows up as MISSING instead of just quietly
vanishing off the page - which is exactly the bug that shipped in v1.
JUNE: adding symbols is cheap in code and expensive in attention. Three
equities is already more than one person can honestly track daily. If you
add more, expect the extra calls to be worse, not better - you'll be
spending the same judgment across more surface.

primary_symbol switched to BTC-USD after the live run: every free keyless equity source returns HTTP 429 from a GitHub runner, while Coinbase serves crypto happily. Crypto also runs 24/7, so you accumulate scored calls about 5x faster than two equity snapshots a day. Switch back to SPY the moment a quote key is in place.

equities moved to equities_parked. NOT deleted - parked. Every free keyless equity source 429s from a GitHub runner, so claiming to track SPY while never fetching it was the page lying to you. Move them back into 'equities' the moment a quote key exists; all the equity and option code is untouched and still tested.
